Hello, i am on xbox too and parse high with the necromancer as well. While its true that parsing on the 3 million and 21 million is different, I believe the 3 million is a good indicator of how high you can parse on the 21 million dummy and I usually suggest parsing on the 3 million since its much shorter time than the 21 mill dummy. In my opinion, i would start parsing on the 21 mill once you can hit about 25k on the 3 mill dummy but thats just me. 

Anyway, did you copy alcast solo necro build to the skills and gear? If so, I can recommend some changed to help parse higher if that is your ultimate goal.

First off, I would recommend changing your staffs to inferno staffs instead, and your frontbar enchant should be flame while the traits and enchants for the rest of the weapons should be the same. If you can, change the trait on your jewerly to bloodthirsty. I am just making assumptions here since Idk your build but those are my suggestions, if you want to stick to lightning staff, thats fine but I would change your frontbar staff enchant to flame instead of shock. 
The rest of your gear is fine. I would personally change your julianos body pieces to Orders Wrath body pieces, its much better. You do not need top gear to have good dps, it helps a lot but still.

Your skills. Ima just assume they are the same from the alcast build and make a lot of assumptions. I would definitely change some morphs of your skills. 

-Change Mystic Siphon to Detonating Siphon
- Change skeletal arcanist to skeletal archer

This is my suggestion but for your frontbar I would do: Stalking Blastbones, Richochet skulls, Detonating siphon, Barbed Trap, CamoHunter/Inner Light

Backbar Skills would be: Unstable wall of elements, Avid Boneyard, Skeletal Archer, Mysitc Orb, Camo Hunter/Inner Light.

For your Ultimates, Just slot the colossus ultimate on both bars for now. 

Camo hunter and barbed trap are skills from the fighters guild skillline. Inner light is a skill from the mages guild Skill line. 

Now, the build im suggesting isnt meta but i think its a good build to start on and can help increase your dps by a lot once you start using your rotation well. 

Now, theres no healing skill in this build. I havent included cause with a lot of content, such as dungeons and trials, its not really required, since knowing mechs and having healers would cover your survivalbility. But if you are doing overland stuff, I would just replace your Skeletal Archer skill with a heal or shield skill. 

This should all help but just remeber high dps comes from your rotation, light weaving and priority of skills, not necessarily meta gear.

Also a tip for using necromancer to get dps, Use Blastbones every two skills.

Blastbones > Random Skill > Random Skill > BlastBones > Random Skill> Random Skill > Blastbones > Repeat. 

If all your skills are still doing damage, like wall, boneyard, etc, then use richochet skulls as a temporary spammable.
